evd_title: Combined LLMs with consistency approach reached 75-88 percent accuracy for PRISMA while deferring 4-74 percent of ratings
finding: Combined LLMs with consistency approach reached 75-88 percent accuracy for PRISMA while deferring 4-74 percent of ratings
P: PRISMA ratings: 27 items x 112 pediatric-surgery SRs/MAs (up to 3,024; Cullis et al.)
I: Ensemble of 9 runs (2x Claude-3-Opus, 2x Claude-2, 1x GPT-4, 2x GPT-3.5, 2x Mixtral-8x22B); consistency threshold 5/9-9/9, temp 0
C: Human consensus of 2 raters (reference); deferred items go to humans
O: PRISMA kappa 0.59 (5/9, 4% deferred) to 0.77 (9/9, 74% deferred); accuracy 75-88%
